info.name: Sahayogi Nepal - Flows (OTP, incidents, pickup, declines)
info.description: Run folders 0 to 4 in order. Each flow submits its own request, so it does not depend on the other collections. Needs base_url, anon_key, admin_email, volunteer_email and password in the environment. Adds requests and 50 litres of drinking water to the demo project on every run.
